verdict.rationale: Devin indexes repositories so it understands the codebase, powering DeepWiki's auto-generated architecture documentation and Ask Devin. Its Knowledge feature provides a collection of instructions that Devin references in all sessions, which together approximate a common knowledge base built from repos. However, nothing explicitly frames this as a team-shared workspace, and nothing shows ingesting the team's own docs alongside repos. Missing for 10: explicit shared team workspace concept, ingestion of external docs (not just repos), and evidence of team-wide access and collaboration on that source of truth, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: Indexing your repositories allows Devin to understand your codebase and enables powerful features like Ask Devin and DeepWiki
Use DeepWiki to navigate architecture and code with auto-generated documentation.
Knowledge is a collection of instructions and advice that Devin can reference in all sessions.
